reuse.why: Keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend and leans on getNextDate in schedule-template, but getUpcomingDates writes its own weekend-skipping loop instead of sharing the filter added to getNextDate.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily'` decision is written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) and the skip-weekend-occurrence loop twice in getNextDate plus once in getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The core rule goes into shared getNextDate, but server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each re-derive the daily case locally.

scope.why: Only the weekend-handling sites, the rrule data and a release note change.

maintainability.why: The daily-vs-move decision is spread over three modules with differently named flags (skipsDays, moveWeekend, skipsWeekendDays) and schedule-template now toggles getNextDate's noSkipWeekend argument to steer it, so the next rule change must be made in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates iterates occurrences and filters d.isWeekend itself rather than going through the shared getNextDate/weekend logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-schedule condition reappears under three names (skipsDays/moveWeekend in schedule-template, skipsWeekendDays in shared/schedules, an inline check in getUpcomingDates), and the keep-filter loop is split into forward and reverse copies.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList.
